high_level_description: This image appears to be a social media post from Nike, as indicated by the logo in the top left corner. The post was made 22 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The image captures a tender moment between two individuals. One person is lifting another person into the air, creating a sense of joy and connection. The person being lifted is wearing a red and green patterned outfit with the word "Kenya" visible on it, suggesting a connection to Kenya. The person lifting them is dressed in a light-colored hoodie and a colorful headscarf, indicating cultural attire.
